newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: HOCKEY-BENFICA FANS ATTACK PORTO TEAM.
newsitem.headline: HOCKEY-BENFICA FANS ATTACK PORTO TEAM.

text.p: Fans of the Lisbon Benfica hockey team attacked players of northern Portuguese side Porto after a match on Wednesday night, seriously injuring three of them, the Porto team doctor Mario Bessa said.

One player, Filipe Santos, suffered a fractured cranium and will undergo surgery after Benfica fans stormed the bus carrying the Porto players and assaulted several members of the team outside the Benfica stadium.
Another player, Pedro Alves, had two broken ribs and Oscar Pereira badly injured his knee, Bessa added.
In a statement, Benfica condemned the attack, said it would pay all costs and made a public apology to Porto players, managers and fans.
The match ended in a 3-3 draw.
